name: Druk
source:
Pronouns: He/Him
Occupation: Drake

Likes: Summer, sports
Dislikes: Laziness, untrustworthy people
Hobbies: Hiking, training, cooking, watching TV

Powers: Enhanced Physical Abilities, Skin Hardening
Signature Technique: Shockwave Force. Druk is able to combine his skin hardening abilities and speed to create shockwaves that can disrupt opponents or nearby terrain.
Dragon Spring: Druk

A highly-ranked Drake, Druk is Kayn's partner at Central. It is said they are an unrivaled duo - their powers and combat techniques a perfect match. A testament to their high rankings, Kayn and Druk were simultaneously able to secure a meeting with Kimura, the head of Central.

While Druk may have appeared distant when you first met, he seems to be the type who quickly warms up to others. He has been offered help the most and seems to feel a responsibility for you. Perhaps this is only because you are only at Central because of him and Kayn.

[From in-game profile]
